name: plx-workbench-desktop
description: PLX Workbench desktop app: the same Workbench, in its own window, with notifications and updates.
author: PLX

scripts.dist:win:signed: node scripts/check-signing.js win && electron-builder --win nsis zip --publish never --config electron-builder.signed.yml
scripts.dist:mac:signed: node scripts/check-signing.js mac && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --arm64 --publish never --config electron-builder.signed.yml
